Manager registers only. No src/, tests/, scripts/, workflows, config/, deploy/.

Merge slot: taken over from whatever terminal automation holder is on main at
push time, and asserted -- only the merge_slot key may differ from origin/main.
R13 requires the claim in the SAME push that arms; verified by running
check_pr_landing.py with the claim dropped, so an armed branch cannot decline
to contend for that single-holder key. That contention is a filed defect, not
a thing this branch chose.
